journey.name: onchain accepted result
journey.description: Verifies that fixed-amount and send-all sends show success only after the configured backend acknowledges the transaction, and that an accepted send finishes its local activity before a new send is admitted. Precondition: an onboarded dev wallet with confirmed savings funds sufficient for both sends and fees, a running synced node, and a second regtest wallet's savings address. The receiving wallet and backend must be test fixtures. Rejected or missing-result cases need a controlled broadcast-refusal/response-loss fixture, which the Capabilities table does not provide, and belong in Manual Tests. A failed local-follow-up acknowledgement also needs a controlled persistence-failure fixture: after Sent activity is saved, remove or reassign its original contact in Details, restart and resume the original send, and verify the edited contact survives without another dispatch. This failure-window case belongs in Manual Tests and focused persistence regression tests. iOS adaptations: accept an Open payment-link prompt if it appears. After the fixed send, mine one block and wait for that exact transaction to confirm. Before the Max leg, choose Settings > Advanced > Coin Selection > Manual. After Continue on Send Amount, select all spendable fixture outputs on Coin Selection and Continue before Confirm. Restore Autopilot afterward. The Manual route is necessary because the amount-less link plus Max currently fails Autopilot Branch and Bound selection with CoinSelectionFailed before native dispatch; this journey does not claim that limitation is fixed. Independently query both exact transaction IDs to verify their recipient amounts and actual input sets.

actions.action: Hand the receiving test wallet address to the app with xcrun simctl openurl <simulator-id> "bitcoin:<test recipient address>?amount=0.00001"
Verify the Send Amount screen is visible with 1 000 sats and Savings selected
Tap Continue (id "ContinueAmount"), expand Show Details (id "SendConfirmToggleDetails") if collapsed, and verify the Confirm screen shows the receiving test wallet address (id "ReviewUri")
Swipe the send handle (id "GRAB") fully to the right
Wait for the Bitcoin Sent success screen (id "SendSuccess") and verify it shows the accepted payment amount

Tap Details (id "Details"), then Explore (id "ActivityTxDetails"), and verify the outbound transaction shows a transaction ID (id "TXID"); record that exact ID without inferring a different transaction from address or amount
Close the transaction details and return to the wallet home screen
Hand the receiving test wallet address to the app again with xcrun simctl openurl <simulator-id> "bitcoin:<test recipient address>"

Tap the available balance (id "AvailableAmount") on Send Amount to choose Max, tap Continue (id "ContinueAmount"), expand Show Details (id "SendConfirmToggleDetails") if collapsed, and verify the Confirm screen shows the receiving test wallet address (id "ReviewUri")
Swipe the send handle (id "GRAB") fully to the right, then tap Yes, Send (id "DialogConfirm") if the over-50%-of-balance confirmation appears

Wait for the Bitcoin Sent success screen (id "SendSuccess"), tap Details (id "Details"), then Explore (id "ActivityTxDetails"), and verify this send-all transaction shows its own exact transaction ID (id "TXID")
